intent.en: Mechanical artifacts commit for the generated R08-RGB guards json so the commit-msg scope check passes; bytes must stay unchanged (local -text attribute like the R02/R05 precedent).

不修改 guards 内容/条目/aggregate；`scripts/validate/render-bvh/guards.json`（R05）与 `guards-r02-skybox.json`（R02）不动。
